In the event of any conflict, discrepancy, or duplication between the conditions in this doc ument and the default/standard terms of the GeM portal, the terms and conditions written in this docu ment shall strictly prevail and take precedence. SECTION 1: FINANCIAL ELIGIBILITY & EARNEST MONEY DEPOSIT (E MD) 1.1 Bidder Turnover Criteria 1.1.1 Minimum Average Annual Turnover of the Bidder (For 3 Years) - ₹20 Lakhs:T he minimum average annual financial turnover of the bidder during the last three years, ending on 31st March 2026 of t he previous financial year, should be as per Gujarat Procurement Policy 2024 Clause No. 3 (Two times Bid Estimated Value) i.e., Minimum ₹20 Lakhs. Documentary evidence in the form of a certificate from the Cha rtered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be upload ed with the bid. In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the bidder is less than 3 years old, the av erage turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account for this criteria. Only exemption is given to Startups having a valid Udyam Registration & NSIC Cer tificate. 1.2 Earnest Money Deposit (EMD) Requirements & Forfeiture 1.2.1 EMD Amount & Instrument: Bidders must furnish an interest-free Earnest Money Deposit (EMD) o f ₹30,000/- (Rupees Thirty Thousand Only) in the form of a Demand Draft (DD) valid for a minimum of 90 d ays. 1.2.2 Payee Details: The Demand Draft must be drawn in favor of "Principal, Dr. S & S S Ghandhy Colleg e of Engineering and Technology, Surat", payable at Surat from any Nationalized or Scheduled Bank. 1.2.3 EMD Envelope Submission: The Demand Draft must be placed in a separate sealed envelope clea rly superscribed as "Envelope 1: Tender Fees and Earnest Money - [Name of Machine/Equipment]". 1.2.4 EMD Exemption: EMD exemption will be granted strictly as per the rules of Gujarat State Procurem ent Policy 2024. Bidders seeking exemption must submit valid Udyam / NSIC / CSPO certificates or relevan t Government exemption proof in Envelope 1. 1.2.5 Rejection of Non-Compliant Offers: Offers received without EMD, or with EMD of insufficient amo unt, or without valid exemption documents shall be summarily rejected. 1.2.6 Return of EMD: The EMD of unsuccessful bidders will be refunded/discharged at the earliest upon c

ompletion of the tender process. The successful bidder's EMD will be discharged upon formal acceptance o f the Purchase Order / LOI. 1.2.7 Forfeiture & Blacklisting: The EMD shall be forfeited if: (a) The bidder withdraws/modifies the bid during the bid validity period; or (b) The successful bidder fails to accept the LOI/Contract or fails to honor quoted prices. In such cases, the bidder shall be debarred/blacklisted from participating in institute tender s for a period of one (1) year. SECTION 2: TECHNICAL & LEGAL ELIGIBILITY CONDITIONS 2.1 Local Service Center & Technical Support in Gujarat 2.1.1 Mandatory Functional Service Center: The Bidder/OEM must possess a fully functional, authoriz ed Service Center in the State of Gujarat, India, to ensure prompt after-sales service, calibration, maintena nce, and technical support. 2.1.2 Documentary Proof: The bidder must upload valid proof showing complete address, contact detail s, and an Escalation Matrix for the Gujarat Service Center. Bids lacking this proof shall be rejected. 2.2 Constitution & Registration of Firm 2.2.1 Eligible Entities: The bidder may be a Proprietary Firm, Partnership Firm, Limited Company, or leg ally constituted Corporate Body engaged in manufacturing/marketing of production machines/equipment. 2.2.2 Registration Certificate: A valid copy of Registration / Incorporation Certificate must be attached with the technical bid. 2.3 OEM Authorization 2.3.1 Compulsory OEM Authorization Certificate: OEM authorization certificate must be compulsorily provided for all items including Base, Receiver (Rover), Controller, Laser Distance Meter, and Rotational La ser Level. 2.3.2 Rejection: Bids submitted without valid OEM Authorization Certificate(s) for all specified equipment shall be summarily rejected. 2.4 Non-Blacklisting & Undertakings 2.4.1 Self-Declaration: The bidder/applicant must not have been blacklisted or debarred by any Depart ment/Ministry of the Government of India, State Government, or PSUs. A formal self-declaration undertakin g must be submitted. SECTION 3: SUPPLY, INSPECTION, WARRANTY & TESTING TERMS 3.1 Delivery, Pricing & Demonstration 3.1.1 FOR Destination Pricing: Prices quoted must be on FOR Destination basis at SSGP Surat, inclusiv e of all taxes, software costs, loading/unloading, transit insurance, and freight charges. 3.1.2 Supply of Genuine Goods: The supplier shall supply only genuine, brand-new articles. The supplie r is fully responsible for transit damage/loss and must replace damaged/lost goods within 10 days of notice at no extra cost. 3.1.3 Complete Delivery Criteria: Delivery will be deemed complete only after physical delivery, full se tup, and satisfactory field demonstration of the equipment at the college premises. 3.1.4 Educational Discount: Special discounts/rebates admissible for educational institutions of national importance should be clearly indicated in the financial bid. 3.2 Inspection, Testing & Rejection 3.2.1 Authority to Inspect: Any officer authorized by SSGP Surat shall have full power to inspect goods before, during, or after manufacture, dispatch, transit, or arrival. 3.2.2 Testing Facilities: The supplier/maker must provide all materials, tools, labor, and testing applianc

es required for inspection without extra charge. 3.2.3 Rejected Goods Protocol: SSGP shall not pay for rejected goods. Failing removal, SSGP may charg e rent for space occupied, and goods will remain at the supplier's risk. 3.3 Comprehensive Warranty & Technical Literature 3.3.1 Warranty Period: The offer must include a comprehensive warranty for at least one (1) year along with one year of free routine servicing. 3.3.2 Brochures & User Lists: Vendors must attach official product brochures/leaflets for the quoted mo del and a client list with complete contact details. 3.3.3 Proprietary Certificate: If the item is of a proprietary nature, a valid Proprietary Item Certificate must be enclosed. If unresolved, legal juris diction shall strictly be within the Courts of Surat, Gujarat only. SECTION 5: MANDATORY SPECIAL TECHNICAL COMPLIANCE (DGPS/ RTK GNSS) 5.1 Special Technical Rules (DGPS Equipment) 5.1.1 CORS Network Compatibility: Equipment must be fully compatible and seamlessly interoperable with both the National CORS Network (Survey of India) and the Gujarat State CORS Network for real-time R TK operations. 5.1.2 Absolute Antenna Calibration: GNSS Rover Receiver antenna absolute calibration file/certificate ( .atx format) from International GNSS Service (IGS) or National Geodetic Survey (NGS) must be submitted. 5.1.3 Receiver Operating System: The DGPS Rover unit must operate on an embedded Linux-based op erating system. 5.1.4 Hardware Physical Channels: Only physical hardware channels are acceptable; virtual/software-i nterpolated channels are strictly prohibited. 5.1.5 OEM ISO 9001 Certification: The OEM of the DGPS system must hold a valid ISO 9001 Quality Ma nagement System certificate.

Field Soft ware should directly calculate remote position by two-point resection method. Instrument must be integrat ed with external laser distance meter and instrument with internal laser distance meter will not qualify. 5.1.14 Third-Party Integration: Provide standard components to integrate into third party applications. 5.1.15 OGC Standards Support: Must have support for OGC standards GeoServer - WMS, WFS and WFS- T. 5.1.16 Manufacturer Authorisation & Lifecycle Documents: Bidder has to provide MAF and other do cuments like 5 year OEM life cycle commitment from GNSS receiver, Controller and Laser Distance Meter OEMs. 5.2 Demonstration & Field Trials 5.2.1 Mandatory Field Demonstration: Bidders shall demonstrate functional performance, RTK accura cy, and CORS connectivity as part of technical evaluation. 5.2.2 Turnaround Notice: Demonstration must be arranged within seven (7) working days of official noti ce. 5.2.3 Venue: Demonstrations and field trials shall be conducted at the Civil Engineering Department, Dr. S. & S.
